_comment: Guided tour of the emtk burst-MLE app. Targets are keys the app records: add_files, detector, auto, window_start, decay, toolAction_run, distribution. The Auto and Fit steps wait for the real press.

steps.title: One lifetime per burst
steps.text:
A burst holds a few hundred photons, so its decay is sparse. This tool fits one lifetime per burst and detector by Poisson maximum likelihood, with the IRF and background held fixed.

Every window shows what the engine computed; with no fit they say so and draw nothing.

steps.title: Burst files
steps.text: Add the burst (.bur) tables of a finished burst analysis: Add files, Add folder, or drop them on the window. The analysis folder they belong to is read whole.

steps.title: Detectors
steps.text: The detectors (routing channels per colour) come from the Detector setup tab, the same editor the other tools use. Pick the one to fit here.

steps.title: IRF and background
steps.text: The fit needs an IRF and a background. Auto IRF/background picks the binning and the fit window, estimates a Gaussian IRF and the background from the photons outside the bursts, and fits. A measured IRF and background give better lifetimes.

steps.title: The fit window
steps.text: The window is the range of micro-time bins that enter the likelihood. Leave out the empty bins before the prompt and the noisy tail. A change refits the current decay.

steps.title: Read the fit
steps.text: The model should follow the data across the whole window. The Fit parameters table gives start, fixed flag and result of tau, gamma, r0 and rho; tau is the lifetime in ns.

steps.title: Fit the bursts
steps.text: Fits every burst of every file and detector in worker processes. The histogram then shows the lifetimes of all bursts and the table their medians.

steps.title: The lifetime distribution
steps.text: Histogram of the fitted per-burst lifetimes. Drag the box to count the bursts in a lifetime gate. A single burst's lifetime is noisy: read the distribution, not one value. Save results writes the per-burst tables beside the burst folders.
